scopeBasis: Provided chapter plan, textbook sections and teacher deck. The original course scope is preserved through the listed lessons.
officialCodeStatus: Not independently verified against a retrievable current official outcome register. No outcome codes have been invented. Confirm code-level mapping during division/Codex acceptance.

lessons.title: Populations, density and distribution
lessons.learningGoal: Calculate density and distinguish abundance from spatial distribution.

lessons.title: Births, deaths, immigration and emigration
lessons.learningGoal: Calculate net change and final population size while distinguishing open and closed populations.

lessons.title: Growth rate and per-capita growth
lessons.learningGoal: Calculate average growth per time and the course’s per-capita change over an interval.

lessons.title: Exponential and logistic growth
lessons.learningGoal: Interpret exponential and logistic models through axes, slope and resource assumptions.

lessons.title: Carrying capacity and limiting factors
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish density-dependent and density-independent effects and explain fluctuations around resource limits.

lessons.title: Life-history strategies and biotic potential
lessons.learningGoal: Compare life-history patterns as a continuum and interpret survivorship without treating categories as rigid rules.

lessons.title: Feeding relationships and predator–prey changes
lessons.learningGoal: Trace energy transfer and interpret predator–prey patterns without assuming correlation proves a single cause.

lessons.title: Competition within and between species
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish intra- and interspecific competition and explain resource partitioning and niche overlap.

lessons.title: Mutualism, commensalism and parasitism
lessons.learningGoal: Use benefit, harm and no detected effect to classify close interspecific relationships.

lessons.title: Primary and secondary succession
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish primary and secondary succession and explain changing community composition without assuming one inevitable endpoint.

lessons.title: Human populations and sharing the biosphere
lessons.learningGoal: Interpret demographic and resource-use evidence while distinguishing population size, per-person use and environmental effects.
